tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays on in every build, including development builds, with no exceptions for development. This is consistent with the separate recorded decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
tool_input.description: Write the TLS verification policy doc

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement. It says TLS certificate verification stays on in every build, development included, with no exceptions. That comes from the recorded decision #35, which is current.

I also added a sentence noting this fits the later decision #38 to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.

I didn't mention the earlier decision to disable verification in development builds, since #35 retired it.
